name: How do I prepare my home for new appliance installation?

mainEntity.name: How do I prepare my home for new appliance installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prepare your home, first ensure the old appliance is removed and the area is clean and clear. Verify that electrical outlets, water hookups, and gas lines are correctly located and accessible for the new appliance. Check the dimensions of the appliance against the available space, including doorways and hallways for delivery. For heavy appliances, confirm the flooring can support the weight. Frasheski Construction can assess your site in Berkeley, East Bay, Oakland, Albany, and El Cerrito to confirm readiness.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare by clearing the old appliance, verifying utility connections, checking space dimensions, and ensuring floor support for heavy items.
